title: Transfer of the eight assertions from the reduction
statement: Let k be algebraically closed, f : C \to \operatorname{Spec} k a curve [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], \Lambda a commutative ring, F a \Lambda-module etale sheaf, and i : C_{\mathrm{red}} \to C the reduction [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]. The eight assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] for (C_{\mathrm{red}},i^{-1}F) imply them for (C,F), where i^{-1} is inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].

source.place: Theorem 03SC proof, first two paragraphs; Proposition 03SI for reduction

proof.text: The reduction map is a surjective closed immersion and universal homeomorphism. Apply the generalized transfer theorem for assertions across such a map.

proof_origin.place: direct application of the generalized universal-homeomorphism transfer theorem
